issues.title: Mid / far rows read light and snowy: tile contrast does not fall off with distance
issues.evidence: q16 (not frame-matched, big picture) rows 3+ patch p90/50 2.16-2.22 and bright 0.28-0.31 vs y_47301 equivalent rows 1.61 / 0.13; right-block backs p90/50 3.35 vs 2.30. At thumbnail scale y_47301 is a deep, near-uniform royal blue block and the render is a speckled, lighter field; q15 rows 37+ show the same. The -0.5 photo-tile mip bias (04_shaders.js ~l.192) keeps sub-pixel strokes alive at 6-15 m where the photo has averaged them.
issues.fix: 04_shaders.js ~l.192 (lighting owner): fade the bias to 0 beyond 3 m and scale the photo-tile excess by k = clamp(1.25 - 0.06 * viewDist, 0.55, 1.0) (tile = mix(1.0, tile, k)) for the y_* layers (16, 24, 25, 26) only. Econ fallback if the shader cannot change: in econUnit far LOD (lod=true) use fabric copies whose PHOTO_GAIN is 0.6 (one line per layer in 03_tex.js). Targets q16 rows 3+: p90/50 1.55-1.75, bright 0.12-0.18; q15 near row numbers unchanged (+-0.02).
